findings.title: Select Health Medical Policy #622: Cervical, Lumbar, and Thoracic Spinal Fusion with or without Spinal Decompression (Neurology/Neurosurgery Policies booklet)
findings.quote: Pain continues after 6 weeks of non-operative therapy including ALL the following (unless contraindicated/not tolerated): a. Analgesics, and b. Activity modification, and c. Physical therapy or chiropractic therapy: minimum of 12 visits within a 6-month period; must have been performed within the previous year
findings.note: Booklet PDF fetched; policy states indication and conservative-care criteria for lumbar fusion; CPT 22612 listed.

findings.title: Select Health Medical Policy #622: Cervical, Lumbar, and Thoracic Spinal Fusion with or without Spinal Decompression (Neurology/Neurosurgery Policies booklet)
findings.quote: Motor deficit or severe radicular pain due to myelopathy with cord compression confirmed by imaging and decompressive surgery expected to result in instability along with ANY of the following: A. Weakness or severe radicular pain; or B. Bowel or bladder dysfunction; or C. Spasticity; or D. Bilateral loss of dexterity; or E. Gait disturbance.
findings.note: Booklet PDF fetched twice; policy #622 states cervical fusion indications (myelopathy, radiculopathy, instability) and conservative-care requirements; CPT 22551 printed in the policy's code list.

findings.title: Select Health Medical Policy #622: Cervical, Lumbar, and Thoracic Spinal Fusion with or without Spinal Decompression (Neurology/Neurosurgery Policies booklet)
findings.note: Booklet PDF fetched: CPT 63030 appears in policy #622's code list, but the policy's criteria address fusion (with or without decompression); no standalone medical-necessity criteria for decompression/microdiscectomy alone were found in Select Health's public policies.
